roleSources.approver: Requires a separately approved, tenant-scoped assignment; not present in current canonical membership enums.

constraints: Every permission check is resource- and tenant-scoped.
Workspace access requires active organisation membership and active membership in that exact workspace under the same organisation.
An actor cannot approve a change that they authored or most recently edited, regardless of role.
delete means soft-delete; permanent purge is not included and requires a separately reviewed policy.
administer is limited to managing access and settings within the actor's authorized tenant scope; it is not platform-wide root access.
Roles and permissions are derived server-side from canonical membership and approved policy; token role, permission, and tenant claims are ignored.
Until business-owner approval and implementation of the permission resolver, effective permissions remain empty and all protected actions are denied.
